info.title: Trendr API
info.description: Trending scores for GitHub, npm, PyPI, Hugging Face, arXiv and the MCP registry.

delete.summary: Delete a watchlist and its items

put.summary: Add an item (idempotent) and promote it to the hot tier

delete.summary: Remove an item from a watchlist

post.summary: Create an alert rule (max 50 per user)

delete.summary: Delete an alert rule and its events

put.summary: Create or replace the weekly-digest subscription

post.summary: Create an API key; the full key is returned once
